newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes lower on technical setback.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes lower on technical setback.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed lower on a technical setback tied to signals the market was overbought after recent rallies to contract highs, traders said.
"This is expensive rice and exports are slowing down," a trader said.
Rice closed two to 3-1/2 cents per cwt lower, with March down 3-1/2 at $12.15 per cwt.
Rice futures volume was estimated by the CBOT at 400 contracts, below the 548 traded Friday.
